name: platinum-bench
description: Platinum-bench is a collection of evaluation tasks intended to measure model performance across a set of natural language tasks, focusing on factual knowledge, reasoning, and general language understanding. The suite aggregates multiple subtasks and reports per-task and aggregate scores to characterize model capabilities. It is provided as a hosted dataset on Hugging Face for easy use in benchmarking.
reputation: A relatively niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption compared to major public leaderboards.
